model1.name: Model 1: NSL Native Full Features
model1.description: Trained only on NSL-KDD with all 41 native domain features (121 encoded). Siloed domain baseline.

model2.name: Model 2: UNSW Native Full Features
model2.description: Trained only on UNSW-NB15 with all 42 native domain features (194 encoded). Siloed domain baseline.

model3.name: Model 3: Harmonized Standard (Unweighted)
model3.description: Trained on all UNSW+NSL flows with 19 core features. No oversampling or class weighting applied.

model4.name: Model 4: Harmonized + Borderline-SMOTE
model4.description: Trained on UNSW+NSL with Borderline-SMOTE synthesizing boundary flows for minority attacks (R2L 995 -> 25,000).

model5.name: Model 5: Harmonized + Class-Weighted
model5.description: Trained on UNSW+NSL with inverse class frequencies applied to penalize minority misclassifications heavily.

model6.name: Model 6: Hybrid (Borderline-SMOTE + Class Weights)
model6.description: Synergistic hybrid combining boundary vector synthesis with inverse class loss penalty.

model7.name: Model 7: Quad Foundation + Borderline-SMOTE
model7.description: Trained on Quad Datasets (UNSW+NSL 301k + CIC+BoT 301k = 602k) with Borderline-SMOTE minority synthesis. Universal cross-era foundation.
